node.statement: Consistency of the pinned display. With t = tau^2 and a = tau/(1+tau) one has a·(tau+t) = t, whence c_v·p_v + c_w·p_w + c_f·p_f = (1-tau)·p_v + (tau+t)·p_w + (-t)·p_f = p_v; equivalently tau·p_v = (tau+t)·p_w - t·p_f, so p_w - p_v = a·(p_f - p_v) and the points v, w, f are collinear with w = v + a·(f - v), a ∈ (0,1). Thus the top-row mass profile (c_v, c_w, c_f) = (1-tau, tau+t, -t), summing to 1 with negative mass t, is an internally consistent idempotence relation reproducing p_v.
